name: Primitive Armour
description: Crude but effective protection cobbled together from whatever materials are at hand. This may include scavenged metal plates, hardened leather, bone, or other improvised materials.

name: Bodyglove
description: A form-fitting suit of flexible synthetic materials that provides minimal protection but allows full freedom of movement. Often worn under other armour for added protection.

name: Mesh Armour
description: Made from thousands of interlocking metal rings, Mesh Armour disperses the force of impacts across its surface. Light and flexible, it offers good protection without sacrificing mobility.

name: Flak Armour
description: Fabricated from layers of impact-absorbent materials, the ablative surface of Flak Armour is particularly resilient to shrapnel and blast damage.

name: Flak Coat
description: A long coat made from layers of impact-resistant materials. Popular among Imperial officers and civilians who need protection without appearing fully armoured.

name: Carapace Armour
description: Made from layered plates of rigid armaplas, Carapace Armour offers excellent protection from direct impacts at the cost of mobility and flexibility.

name: Tempestus Carapace
description: Elite Militarum Tempestus Scions wear specially fitted Carapace Armour designed for mobility. The armour's streamlined design allows for rapid deployment from Valkyries and other aircraft.

name: Skitarii War Plate
description: Augmented with servo-motors and blessed by the Omnissiah, Skitarii War Plate is grafted directly to its wearer. The armour becomes part of the warrior's enhanced body.

name: Light Power Armour
description: By reducing the bulk of the ceramite plating, Light Power Armour offers the benefits of servo-boosted strength and a shell of durable ceramite, without sacrificing mobility or nimbleness.

name: Sororitas Power Armour
description: Manufactured for the exclusive use of the Sisters of Battle, Sororitas Power Armour is blessed and purified with religious fervour to protect its wearer from the heretic and daemon alike.

name: Ignatus Power Armour
description: Prized by safety conscious Inquisitors, this highly-prized masterwork armour is effective at turning aside countless blows that would endanger the life of the high-ranking individual encased in its engraved and emblazoned shell.

name: Heavy Power Armour
description: Sacrificing mobility for thicker plating and industrial grade actuators, Heavy Power Armour turns its wearer into a walking tank, capable of striding through a storm of small arms fire without so much as flinching.

name: Scout Armour
description: Thick ceramite plates combine with exceptionally tough carbon-weave fatigues to provide unparalleled protection on the battlefield without sacrificing mobility.

name: Aquila Power Armour (Mk VII)
description: Towering suits of battle-hardened Power Armour, Astartes armour is specifically designed to interface with the enhanced physique and genetically engineered organs of the transhuman warriors of the Adeptus Astartes.

name: Mark X Tacticus Armour
description: The standard armour of Primaris Space Marines. The Mark X Tacticus represents the pinnacle of power armour design, combining the best elements of previous marks with new innovations from Cawl.

name: Terminator Armour
description: Massive suits of armour that turn their wearers into unstoppable juggernauts. Originally designed for boarding actions in the hostile environments of space hulks, Terminator Armour can withstand tremendous punishment.

name: Corsair Armour
description: Lightweight armour favoured by Aeldari Corsairs who prize mobility over protection. Often decorated with the colours and symbols of the Corsair's fleet.

name: Aeldari Mesh Armour
description: Woven from the psycho-plastic materials of the Craftworlds, Aeldari Mesh Armour is lighter and more flexible than its Imperial equivalent while offering comparable protection.

name: Rune Armour
description: Worn by Aeldari Farseers and Warlocks, Rune Armour incorporates protective psychic runes that ward against both physical and warp-based attacks. The runes flare with power when deflecting blows.

name: Heavy Mesh Armour
description: A heavier version of standard Aeldari mesh, incorporating additional layers of protective materials. Favoured by Corsair leaders who expect to face significant enemy fire.

name: Ork Flak
description: Orks cobble together whatever protection they can from scrap metal and salvage. The result is surprisingly effective, if somewhat ramshackle in appearance.

name: 'Eavy Armour
description: Made from thick plates of salvaged metal bolted together, 'Eavy Armour provides substantial protection. Only the biggest and toughest Orks can bear its weight.

name: Mega Armour
description: The heaviest armour available to Orks, Mega Armour turns its wearer into a walking fortress. Built with looted power systems and salvaged plating, each suit is unique.

name: Storm Shield
description: A large shield incorporating a power field generator that can deflect even the most devastating attacks. Storm Shields are used by elite Space Marine warriors.

name: Refractor Field
description: A personal force field generator that disperses incoming attacks across a shimmering energy barrier. Common among Imperial officers and nobles who can afford such protection.

name: Rosarius
description: A holy symbol of the Ecclesiarchy that incorporates a potent conversion field. The Rosarius is worn by Chaplains and high-ranking members of the Adeptus Ministorum as a sign of their faith and office.

name: Aspect Armour
description: Each Aspect Shrine maintains its own pattern of armour, designed to complement the fighting style of that Aspect. The armour incorporates psychic wards that offer protection beyond its physical form.

name: Heavy Aspect Armour
description: Worn by Aspect Warriors who favour durability over speed, Heavy Aspect Armour provides increased protection while still incorporating the psychic wards common to all Aspect equipment.

name: Ghostplate Armour
description: Worn by Drukhari Archons and other high-ranking Dark Eldar, Ghostplate Armour incorporates advanced stealth and protection technologies. It can turn aside blows that would otherwise prove fatal.

name: Holo-Suit
description: Worn by Harlequins, the Holo-Suit projects a constantly shifting holographic display that makes its wearer nearly impossible to target. The effect is as disorienting as it is beautiful.

name: Incubus Warsuit
description: The distinctive armour of the Incubi, these warsuits are ornate and heavily layered. Each is a work of art, reflecting the wearer's dedication to the art of killing.

name: Kabalite Armour
description: The standard armour of Drukhari Kabalite Warriors, this lightweight protection allows for rapid movement. Often decorated with the colours and sigils of the wearer's Kabal.

name: Mesh Implants
description: Created by the Haemonculi, Mesh Implants are protective materials woven beneath the skin. The disturbing appearance of these subcutaneous protections inspires fear in those who witness them.

name: Reaper Armour
description: The heavy armour of Dark Reapers is designed for stability when firing their devastating Reaper Launchers. The suit's weight allows the wearer to brace against the weapon's recoil.

name: Wych Suit
description: Wyches of the Drukhari wear minimal armour, relying on speed and agility for protection. Their suits are designed to display their athletic forms while providing token physical protection.

name: Force Shield
description: An Aeldari Force Shield projects a shimmering barrier of psychic energy. Used by Autarchs and other commanders, these shields can deflect incoming attacks through pure willpower.

name: Gloom Field
description: Used by Rangers and other scouts, the Gloom Field projects an area of deep shadow around the wearer. Allies within this zone benefit from the concealment it provides.

name: Mistshield
description: A Corsair Mistshield creates a shimmering field of displaced light and sound that makes its bearer difficult to target. The field flickers with iridescent colours when struck.

name: Serpent Shield Platform
description: A larger defensive field used on Aeldari vehicles and heavy weapons platforms. The Serpent Shield can absorb significant amounts of incoming fire before failing.

name: Shadowfield
description: The ultimate personal protection of Drukhari Archons, the Shadowfield wraps its wearer in absolute darkness. Almost nothing can penetrate this barrier while it remains active.

name: Shimmershield
description: An advanced defensive field used by Craftworld commanders. The Shimmershield projects an area effect that can protect nearby allies from incoming fire.

name: Sicarian Battle Armour
description: Worn by Sicarian Ruststalkers and Infiltrators, this armour incorporates advanced stealth systems and servo-enhanced mobility. Each suit is permanently bonded to its wearer.

name: Bullgryn Plate
description: Heavy armour designed for Bullgryns, these massive plates of carapace can turn aside heavy weapons fire. The armour must be sized for the Ogryn's immense bulk.

name: Kroot Armour
description: Made from layered hide and chitin, Kroot Armour reflects the species' preference for natural materials. It is surprisingly effective while allowing full freedom of movement.

name: Mark X Phobos Armour
description: A lighter variant of Mark X armour designed for Vanguard units. The Phobos pattern incorporates enhanced stealth systems and is favoured by Reivers and Incursors.

name: Artificer Power Armour
description: Custom-crafted by master artificers, each suit of Artificer Armour is a unique masterwork. Worn by Captains and other heroes, this armour offers superior protection to standard patterns.

name: Tactical Dreadnought Armour (Terminator)
description: The mighty Terminator armour represents the pinnacle of personal protection for Space Marines. Originally designed for space hulk boarding actions, it can withstand tremendous punishment.

name: Wychsuit
description: The revealing bodysuit of Drukhari Wyches, designed for maximum agility in the gladiatorial arenas. The suit provides minimal protection, as Wyches rely on speed to survive.

name: Cloak of Skin
description: Worn by Mandrakes, this grotesque cloak is woven from the flayed flesh of victims. Its appearance inspires horror in those who witness it, while providing supernatural protection.

name: War Mask
description: Aspect Warriors use war masks to help focus their aggression and enter their war personae. The mask serves as a psychological barrier between the peaceful Aeldari and the killer within.

name: Forceshield
description: An Aeldari shield that projects a barrier of pure psychic energy. The Forceshield can deflect both physical and warp-based attacks through the will of its bearer.

name: Mist Shield
description: Used by Corsair warriors, the Mist Shield projects a swirling barrier of distortion that makes incoming attacks difficult to aim. The shield flickers with ethereal light.
